name: tia_export_aml
description: Export hardware configuration as CAx/AutomationML (.aml) with CaxProvider.Export, for the whole project or one device. Siemens drives (Startdrive) and most HMI devices are not included by Siemens CAx; GSDML IO devices such as third-party drives are.

output_path.description: Full path of the .aml file to write.

device_name.description: Optional device to export; omit for the whole project.
